title: Thematic Outlook: We have entered the age of thematic investing
summary: We're living through what feels like a constant string of ChatGPT moments, just spread across different themes instead of one. This blog summarises the key messages from our Autumn 2026 thematic outlook, covering strategic metals, European infrastructure, AI infrastructure, physical AI, quantum computing and the space economy, and why we think this is only getting more exciting.
